overall: Violation found: the Committee failed to timely approve minutes for three 2022 meetings. Request-response and website-posting allegations were declined; the AG ordered approval, delivery of minutes, and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly failed to timely create and approve minutes for its February 16, June 15, and November 16, 2022 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely approve minutes for its meetings held on February 16, June 15, and November 16, 2022.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to respond to requests for meeting minutes, without identifying any specific request.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review this allegation where the complaint does not identify any particular request for minutes that the Committee failed to respond to.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to post its meeting minutes to a website.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review this allegation because, even if true, it does not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Approve minutes for the February 16, June 15, and November 16, 2022 meetings within 30 days of the determination date.
Provide the approved minutes for those three meetings to the complainant within 30 days.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee to approve minutes for all three meetings and to provide these minutes to the Complainant within 30 days of the date of this letter.
